section.57: One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)

57.name_native: One-fifth of Booty to the Cause of Allah (Khumus)

hadiths.text: Narrated `Aisha:(the wife of the Prophet) When the sickness of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got aggravated, he asked the permission of his wives that he should be treated in my house, and they permitted him
